sources.title: FCSC UAE Numbers 2009, Population by Emirate census table
sources.reuse_note: Official FCSC 2009 report PDF. AreaData adopted only the December 2005 census population table for seven emirates and national; other pages and 1975/1985/1995 columns await semantic review. Do not call it current population or assume 2017 reference shapes are certified 2005 geography.

sources.title: SCAD Abu Dhabi Census 2024 population and three-region table
geographic_levels: Abu Dhabi/Al Ain/Al Dhafra statistical regions
sources.reuse_note: SCAD 2024 administrative-register population with revised 2023 R1 regional values. It covers Abu Dhabi only; regional counts are rounded to multiples of five. Kit must review raw table, code/boundary identities, methods, terms and other emirate sources independently.

sources.title: UAE government overview of Dubai 2040 Urban Master Plan
sources.publisher: Official Portal of the UAE Government
sources.reuse_note: Official government overview of Dubai 2040 Urban Master Plan. Full plan text, current implementation, local budgets and selected-area relevance need separate acquisition; do not treat the overview as an approved local planning dossier.

sources.title: FCSC UAE.Stat official population-estimate explorer
reference_periods: national population series shown through 2024; emirate scope unverified
sources.reuse_note: Official UAE.Stat population-estimate explorer lead. The visible national series through 2024 is not proof of available comparable emirate rows. Verify actual dataflow, subnational coverage, method, format and terms before adoption.

sources.title: SSC 2024 administrative territorial classification
sources.publisher: State Statistical Committee of the Republic of Azerbaijan
sources.reuse_note: Official SSC 1 May 2024 code classification. AreaData held three apparent city-versus-district label conflicts with 2026 population rows; the PDF does not provide 2026 local polygons or verify historical geography. Kit must recheck codes, type, version and terms.

sources.title: 2019 population census Volume A
sources.publisher: State Statistical Committee of the Republic of Azerbaijan
sources.reuse_note: Official SSC 2019 census Volume A ZIP/PDF location. AreaData acquired the 470-page volume but inspected only front matter; no Volume A fields were directly adopted. Kit must inventory every relevant table, geography, definitions and reuse terms independently.

sources.title: 2019 population census Volume B
sources.publisher: State Statistical Committee of the Republic of Azerbaijan
sources.reuse_note: Official SSC 2019 census Volume B ZIP/PDF location. AreaData acquired the 584-page volume but inspected only front matter; no Volume B fields were directly adopted. Household, housing and migration tables need independent Kit audit.

sources.title: SSC demography table 1.15: area, 2019 and 2026 population
sources.publisher: State Statistical Committee of the Republic of Azerbaijan
sources.reuse_note: New official SSC table 1.15 lead. AreaData adopted rounded 2019 census-basis and 1 January 2026 population for selected rows; Aghdara 2019 is missing. Kit must independently inspect source geography, other fields, current edition and reuse terms. These are thousand people, not exact persons or WDI midyear values.

sources.title: SSC demography table 1.17: historical regional population
sources.publisher: State Statistical Committee of the Republic of Azerbaijan
sources.reuse_note: New official SSC historical population table 1.17 location. AreaData inventoried its 1979–2019 fields but adopted none; changing territorial groupings, row definitions and reuse terms require independent assessment.

sources.title: SSC demography table 1.19: population by sex, 2026
sources.publisher: State Statistical Committee of the Republic of Azerbaijan
sources.reuse_note: New official SSC 2026 sex and settlement table. AreaData adopted total-row men/women only after matching 101 rows to table 1.15; urban/rural and settlement fields remain unassessed. Rounded thousands and source geography need independent Kit audit.

sources.title: Azerbaijan Urban Planning and Construction Code
sources.publisher: Official website of the President of Azerbaijan
sources.reuse_note: Official presidential page locates Urban Planning and Construction Code Articles 17–20. Current consolidated amendments, applicable plan maker, actual local plans and approvals need legal/content review before any planning claim.

sources.title: State Committee on Urban Planning and Architecture master-plan catalogue
sources.publisher: State Committee on Urban Planning and Architecture
geographic_levels: selected cities and regions; area coverage to verify
sources.reuse_note: ARXKOM official master-plan catalogue lead. Individual plan body, approval instrument, period, selected-area relevance, budget, implementation and evaluation were not adopted by AreaData and require independent Kit review.

sources.title: SSC regional statistics yearbook catalogue
sources.publisher: State Statistical Committee of the Republic of Azerbaijan
geographic_levels: national and regional availability to verify
sources.reuse_note: Official SSC regional statistics page lists the large 2025 Regions of Azerbaijan yearbook. AreaData did not download or inspect its fields; this is location only, not evidence of specific local indicator coverage.

sources.title: Government notice on commune-status decree
sources.publisher: Service d’information du Gouvernement du Burkina Faso
sources.reuse_note: Government notice describes a 2026 commune-status decree but does not supply a verified 2019-to-current unit crosswalk. Locate the decree and official unit list before joining current authorities to census communes.

sources.title: Fichier des localités du 5e RGPH (2019)
sources.publisher: Institut national de la statistique et de la démographie (INSD)
sources.reuse_note: Official 2019 locality population by sex and age, including source-noted estimates for security-affected places. Use the 2019 13-region/45-province/351-commune geography; do not relabel it as the 2025 17-region/47-province system. Recheck raw redistribution terms.

sources.title: Guide méthodologique de planification locale: PCD (December 2024)
sources.publisher: Ministère de l’Économie et des Finances
sources.reuse_note: December 2024 communal development-plan (PCD) guide predates the 2025 territorial code and administrative reform. Check the guide's current applicability and the chosen locality's legal planning authority; no local plan is implied.

sources.title: Guide méthodologique de planification locale: PRD (December 2024)
sources.publisher: Ministère de l’Économie et des Finances
sources.reuse_note: December 2024 regional development-plan (PRD) guide predates the 2025 territorial code and administrative reform. Do not equate a 2019 statistical region with a current planning body without legal crosswalk.

sources.title: Government notice on 30 July 2026 territorial competence-transfer decrees
sources.publisher: Service d’information du Gouvernement du Burkina Faso
sources.reuse_note: New AreaData location: 30 July 2026 official council notice reports competence and resource transfer decrees under law 024-2025/ALT. Signed decree texts, numbers, commencement and selected-area application are not acquired; this is not a plan or budget.

sources.title: Loi n°024-2025/ALT portant Code général des collectivités territoriales
sources.publisher: Assemblée législative de transition / Académie de Police du Burkina Faso
sources.reuse_note: Law no. 024-2025/ALT cover and parliamentary adoption were checked. The 114-page posted PDF is scanned; its article-level requirements and present applicability were not text-verified. Verify exact articles and current consolidated status before prescribing a planning index.

sources.title: MATM / CONAFIL local-finance publications
sources.publisher: Conseil national de la statistique / Ministère de l’Administration territoriale et de la Mobilité
sources.reuse_note: Official MATM/CONAFIL catalogue lists local-government budget forecasts and transferred-resource execution reports. Inspect each report body and local identifiers; a forecast is not an approved area budget or actual execution.

sources.title: Komsilga communal development-plan procurement notice
sources.publisher: Direction générale du contrôle des marchés publics et des engagements financiers
sources.reuse_note: Official 2025 procurement notice for preparing Komsilga's PCD. This is a lead to the planning process, not a completed or approved plan, local budget or implementation result. Verify current commune identity.

sources.title: Rapport national 2024 sur les plans locaux de développement
sources.publisher: Ministère de l’Économie et des Finances, DGDT
sources.reuse_note: National 2024 monitoring report on local development plans, published in 2025. It is a planning-system reference, not evidence that any selected commune's plan or budget was obtained or approved. Check any area-specific document separately.

sources.title: Disparités communales de la pratique contraceptive au Burkina Faso
sources.publisher: Institut national de la statistique et de la démographie (INSD)
reference_periods: 2015 outcome model, 2019 census covariates; August 2023 report
sources.reuse_note: This is a modelled 2015 outcome using 2019 census covariates, not 2019 contraceptive prevalence. Three ambiguous commune name matches were withheld; review the crosswalk and raw reuse terms.

sources.title: RGPH 2019 Volume 3: Mesure et cartographie de la pauvreté
sources.publisher: Institut national de la statistique et de la démographie (INSD)
reference_periods: 2018 household survey with 2019 census frame; Annexes 5-9 use RGPH 2019
sources.reuse_note: Volume 3 Annex 4 monetary-poverty values are small-area estimates combining EHCVM 2018 with 2019 census geography, not directly enumerated census poverty. Annexes 5-9 report distinct census measures. Two whole-city commune aggregates and four incomplete rows were withheld; recheck definitions, geography, and redistribution terms.

sources.title: Résultats du 5e RGPH: volume des tableaux statistiques
sources.publisher: Institut national de la statistique et de la démographie (INSD)
sources.reuse_note: Official statistical-table volume has 581 identified table headings; 17 have selected adopted values, 11 have reviewed decisions without new adoption, and 553 await semantic review. Table II.10 fertility values conflict with the final report's prose and figure (AreaData evidence: burkina-faso-fertility-source-conflict-2026-09-25.md); do not adopt or reconcile them automatically. Inspect numeric columns, denominators and source versions; regional rates are not commune rates.

sources.title: INSD regional statistical yearbooks catalogue, including 2024 editions
sources.publisher: Institut national de la statistique et de la démographie (INSD)
reference_periods: 2023 and 2024 regional yearbook listings; individual coverage varies
sources.reuse_note: New AreaData location: official INSD regional yearbook catalogue lists 2024 and 2023 editions. Individual PDFs, numeric tables, terms and 2025 geography correspondence are not audited or adopted.

sources.title: Annuaire statistique national 2024
sources.publisher: Institut national de la statistique et de la démographie (INSD)
sources.reuse_note: INSD 2024 national yearbook contains regional and commune fiscal tables and source caveats. Reacquire the full PDF, check numeric columns and null-value notes, and reconcile historical geography before adoption.

sources.title: Population and Housing Census 2022: Preliminary Report
sources.reuse_note: Reused from the Kit Bangladesh project, not newly discovered by AreaData. Recheck the current BBS page and exact report before acquisition; AreaData independent audit and redistribution-terms review are pending.

sources.title: Population and Housing Census 2022: District Community Series (64 workbooks)
sources.reuse_note: Reused from the Kit Bangladesh project, not newly discovered by AreaData. Verify each district workbook and local geography independently; AreaData audit and source-terms review are pending.

sources.title: COSIT Iraq 2024 census electricity household table
sources.reuse_note: New official COSIT table. Electricity-source counts can overlap; the regular-responding-household denominator differs from the domestic-water table. Kit must audit its own source rows and geography; AreaData has no independent ACCEPT.

sources.title: COSIT Iraq 2024 census water household table
sources.reuse_note: New official COSIT primary water source used at home table. Piped inside dwelling is not a drinking-water or safe-water measure; denominator and categories differ from electricity. Kit must audit independently.

sources.title: COSIT final results of the 2024 Population and Housing Census
sources.publisher: Iraq Commission of Statistics and GIS (COSIT)
sources.license_or_terms: CC BY 4.0 portal envelope; resource terms review pending
sources.reuse_note: New AreaData source location: Iraq COSIT 2024 final census summary in the government open-data portal. AreaData checked 18 governorate rows and five numeric columns locally. Kit must independently audit its own acquisition, adjusted versus original population definitions, code/boundary matching and resource-specific terms before adoption.

sources.title: COSIT Iraq 2024 census table catalogue
sources.reuse_note: New COSIT official 2024 census table catalogue location. Thirty PDFs were listed; seven acquired by AreaData and two household-service tables locally adapted. Kit must independently audit acquisition, every table field, official geography, terms and adoption.

sources.title: CBS 2022 Census households selected characteristics
reference_periods: 2022 Census estimate and 2008 Census estimate; fields unassessed
sources.reuse_note: Official CBS selected-household-characteristics workbook newly located by AreaData. File includes 2022 and 2008 Census estimates; no numeric field adopted. Kit must inspect denominators, geography, period and terms.

sources.title: CBS 2022 Census population households locality
sources.reuse_note: Official CBS locality population and household workbook newly located by AreaData. It lists 1,220 locality codes, but its population listing does not reconcile to the broad-geography nationwide value; no fields adopted. Kit must review coverage, code history, missingness and terms.

sources.title: CBS 2022 Census population group religion age sex
sources.reuse_note: Official CBS 2022 population-group, religion, age and sex workbook newly located by AreaData. Sheet structure only was inventoried; no field adopted. Verify group definitions, geography, denominators and reuse terms.

sources.title: CBS 2022 Census population selected characteristics
reference_periods: 2022 Census estimate, end-2021 population estimate and 2008 Census estimate; fields unassessed
sources.reuse_note: Official CBS selected-population-characteristics workbook newly located by AreaData. File includes 2022 Census, end-2021 estimate and 2008 Census reference material; no numeric field adopted. Distinguish periods and methods before Kit reuse.

sources.title: CBS 2022 Census selected data localities statistical areas
sources.reuse_note: Official CBS 2022 workbook newly located by AreaData. Locality and statistical-area aggregate rows were profiled but no numeric field adopted; listed locality population does not cover the broad-geography nationwide value. Kit must assess coverage, codes, scope, methods and reuse terms independently.

sources.title: CBS 2022 Census broad geographical units
sources.reuse_note: Official CBS broad-geography workbook newly located by AreaData. Only eight fields in nationwide plus seven first-level 2022 rows were adopted; the other 446 fields of that sheet and eight other sheets remain unassessed. Area 7 covers Israeli localities in Judea and Samaria only, not all residents. The six 2006 reference shapes were not joined. Kit must review raw, geography, methods and terms independently.

sources.title: Planning Administration Mavat plan submission guidance
geographic_levels: plan submission process; applicable area to verify
sources.reuse_note: Official Mavat procedural guidance location only. AreaData did not adopt a current mandatory local format or an approved plan from it. Kit must inspect content, applicability and edition independently.

sources.title: Planning Administration planning and building laws index
geographic_levels: national law index; applicable local unit to verify
sources.reuse_note: Official Planning Administration laws index only. Current consolidated legal text, lawful plan maker and local duties were not adopted by AreaData; do not infer a planning obligation from this link alone.

sources.title: Planning Administration XPLAN online plan search
geographic_levels: plan search; selected-area coverage to verify
sources.reuse_note: Official Planning Administration XPLAN plan-search service location only. AreaData acquired no selected-area plan body, approval, budget, implementation or evaluation record. Kit must search and verify documents independently.

sources.title: DoS 2015 Population and Housing Census, Table 2.17: main drinking-water source
sources.reuse_note: New AreaData 2015 census Table 2.17 original for main drinking-water source by governorate. AreaData audited seven numeric fields and partially adopted public-network counts/shares, but Kit must independently verify the PDF, excluded households, numerator/denominator, official geography and terms. Public network does not establish safe water.

sources.title: DoS 2025 Population Estimates by Municipality
sources.reuse_note: New AreaData source location. The workbook was acquired and mechanically inventoried, but no municipal value was adopted. Municipality and administrative district are separate classifications; Kit must audit identities and terms independently.

sources.title: DoS 2025 Population Estimates, Tables 2.2, 2.3 and 2.6
sources.reuse_note: New AreaData source location: 2025 DoS urban/rural and population-density workbook. Values are annual estimates and reported area, not a new census or a 2006 geoBoundaries calculation. Kit must independently verify cells, definitions, codes and terms.

sources.title: DoS 2025 Population Estimates by Locality, Sex and Households
sources.reuse_note: New AreaData source location: DoS annual end-2025 population estimates based on the 2015 census, not a 2025 census. AreaData partially adopted the summary, but Kit must independently audit raw fields, official codes, boundary edition, terms and any adoption.

sources.title: Guide for the Preparation of Governorate Strategic Development and Implementation Plans
sources.reuse_note: New AreaData source location for the 2018 Ministry of Interior guide. It cites the 2015 decentralization law. Current applicability under the 2021 local administration law and any actual governorate plan remain unverified.

sources.title: Local Administration Law No. 22 of 2021
sources.reuse_note: New AreaData source location for a 53-page image PDF titled Local Administration Law No. 22 of 2021. Articles, amendments and current planning duties require OCR or manual legal review before adoption.

sources.title: DoS 2015 Population and Housing Census statistical table catalogue
geographic_levels: governorate and other levels to verify per table
sources.reuse_note: New AreaData official 2015 census catalogue location. One separate Table 2.17 PDF was acquired and partially adopted by AreaData; the remaining individual thematic tables, source fields, geography and terms have not been fully audited. The 2025 estimate workbooks are separate.

sources.title: Results of Population and Housing Census 2015
sources.publisher: Lao Statistics Bureau / UNFPA Lao PDR
sources.license_or_terms: Source-site public access terms; redistribution status reviewed per retained file
sources.reuse_note: Reused from the Kit Lao project, not newly discovered by AreaData. This is the detailed 2015 census, not published 2025 local census results. Recheck report and geography; AreaData independent audit is pending.

sources.title: Lao PDR Subnational Population Statistics 2024
sources.publisher: UNFPA / Lao Statistics Bureau, distributed by HDX
sources.reuse_note: Reused from the Kit Lao project, not newly discovered by AreaData. UNFPA/LSB 2024 population statistics distributed via HDX are not 2024 census counts; recheck definitions, geography and redistribution terms.

sources.title: Ministry of Health Statistical Yearbook 2022, Table 1-12
sources.reuse_note: New AreaData source location: Saudi Ministry of Health 2022 yearbook Table 1-12 cites GASTAT for the 2022 census population of 13 administrative regions. Its 2010–2021 columns are recalculated estimates, not census counts. Kit must independently audit direct GASTAT tables, geographic codes/boundaries, terms and adoption.

sources.title: CBS 2004 census population and housing by district/sub-district (archived original)
sources.reuse_note: Archived copy of original CBS 2004 district/sub-district PDF. AreaData adopted historical population and sex counts only. Lower housing rows are unresolved; P-codes are not verified official codes, and Kit must independently audit source rows and current relevance.

sources.title: CBS 2004 census population and housing by governorate (archived original)
sources.reuse_note: Archived copy of an original CBS 2004 governorate PDF, not a live current CBS endpoint. AreaData adopted six historical count fields; current population, legal boundary equivalence, reuse terms and independent Kit audit remain open. The old cbssyr.sy site returned HTTP 403 in this session.

sources.title: OCHA-hosted mirror of Syrian 2004 census workbook (archived)
sources.publisher: UN OCHA mirror of Syrian CBS census material
sources.reuse_note: Archived OCHA distribution of CBS census material. AreaData uses English labels and P-codes only: 213 numeric fields conflict with original CBS PDFs. Do not adopt mirror numbers or its separate 2009/2010 sheets without independent reconciliation, geography and terms review.

sources.title: SANA report on proposed local development planning method, 23 October 2025
sources.reuse_note: Official SANA report describes discussion of a proposed 2025 governorate local-development planning method. The method text, legal planning duty, actual selected-area plan and approval have not been obtained; the article is a lead, not adopted guidance.

sources.title: Ministry of Finance citizen budget 2026, national document lead
sources.reuse_note: Official Ministry of Finance 2026 national citizen-budget location. AreaData has not audited its table fields. It is not a selected governorate plan, local budget execution or official evaluation.

sources.title: TÜİK ADNKS 2025 — favorite tables
sources.reuse_note: New AreaData source location: TÜİK 2025 annual ADNKS population register, not a decennial census. AreaData locally checks province/district totals, but Kit must audit its own acquisition, source fields, 2025 geography, reuse terms and adoption independently.

sources.title: UBOS NPHC 2024 subcounty profiles — Uganda-LGDP normalized extraction
sources.reuse_note: AreaData adapted Uganda-LGDP normalized UBOS 2024 census data. The original UBOS workbook was not present in the adapter source checkout; reacquire and verify official originals and scope, including APAA, before use. Independent AreaData audit is pending.

sources.title: Local Government Development Planning Guidelines, second edition
sources.reuse_note: AreaData inherited this NPA guidance location through Uganda-LGDP resources. Verify the exact edition, applicability and PDF before use; AreaData independent audit and redistribution-terms review are pending.

sources.title: NPA local government plan catalogue
sources.reuse_note: NPA local-government plan catalogue location only. Area-specific plans, dates, duplicates and content must be checked individually; no plan is assumed current or adopted in Kit.

sources.title: CSO 2004 census main report location
geographic_levels: governorate and district coverage to inspect
sources.reuse_note: New official CSO URL for a 2004 main report. AreaData acquisition returned HTTP 200 non-PDF content; no numbers adopted. Reacquire authentic original and verify its administrative epoch before any use.

sources.title: Yemen Local Authority Law No. 4 of 2000
sources.reuse_note: New parliament location for original Law No. 4 of 2000. A 40-page PDF was acquired, but current consolidated applicability, amendments and actual local plan status are unverified.

sources.title: CSO governorate statistical yearbook catalogue
sources.reuse_note: New CSO location lists 2024 and older governorate statistical yearbooks. Individual files, table fields, geography and terms have not been audited or adopted by AreaData.
